description:
www.Longevity960.com is the premier online platform, dedicated to redefining the art of living longer, healthier, and more vibrantly through Systemic Longevity—a holistic, science-backed approach that integrates personalized longevity medicine, optimized home environments, and community well-being for true healthspan extension.

About our brand and products:

Longevity960 offers cutting-edge longevity protocols, services, and products tailored for individuals, real estate developers, and communities worldwide. Our flagship offerings include at-home diagnostic testing analyzing 960+ biomarkers (delving into advanced metrics like epigenetics, metabolomics, rare biomarkers, and even microplastics exposure), conducted conveniently by a certified nurse in your home. We provide comprehensive packages such as the Platinum At-Home Health Assessment with one-year elite follow-up, including unlimited consultations with world-class physicians in longevity, genomics, and preventive medicine. Additional products feature tools like the First AI Peptides Bar .Everything supports Systemic Longevity: biological optimization combined with home and social factors inspired by blue zones research.

What makes us different:

Unlike standard wellness brands focused on isolated supplements or generic advice, Longevity960 stands out with its Systemic Longevity framework—treating aging as interconnected systems where biology, environment, and lifestyle amplify each other. Ourunique home optimization tools, and scalable solutions positioning us at the forefront of proactive, evidence-based longevity in 2026's booming healthspan market.

How affiliates can earn:

As an influencer or partner in our affiliate program, you'll earn generous 14% commissions on every successful referral through your unique link—whether from product sales (e.g., diagnostic packages, water testers, IV services), service bookings, or high-ticket assessments. 

How to promote us:

Influencers thrive by authentically sharing their own longevity journey—post about taking our at-home 960+ biomarker test, revealing personalized insights, optimizing home water quality for better health, or experiencing NAD+ boosts. Use engaging formats like Reels/TikToks on "my longevity morning routine," before/after biomarker stories, home wellness setups, or educational content on systemic longevity vs. traditional aging. Leverage our hashtags (#Longevity #Healthspan #SystemicLongevity #Biohacking #AtHomeDiagnostics) and provided creatives. Target audiences passionate about wellness, biohacking, anti-aging, and mindful home living for high conversion. We support with affiliate resources, tracking links, and collaboration ideas to make promotion seamless and impactful.

We're building a community of forward-thinking creators who align with evidence-based, transformative health. In a world where people increasingly invest in proactive longevity (from at-home testing to environmental tweaks), partnering with Longevity960 lets you monetize your influence while genuinely helping your audience live longer, healthier lives. Ready to elevate your content and earnings with the future of wellness? Let's craft longevity together!
